Bhutan

Artist

Nyendra
Thukten Nyendra
b. 2001 or 2002
📍 Mebisa
His mother initially opposed his music career and advised him to find a more stable job. After he won the national selection, she expressed how proud she was of him.

Country

public selection
In 2025, Bhutan launched a national selection for the yet-unannounced Eurovision Asia, revealing plans for the contest to fans for the first time. However, after four of the five planned episodes, the selection was cancelled just one day before the final at the request of Eurovision's rights holders, and all episodes were removed from the internet.
On 11 August 2026, Bhutan became the first country to select its Eurovision Asia entry.
